# Recorded from a real Argo CD: a three-level app-of-apps

Captured on 2026-10-10 in the GitOps E2E lane of CI run 38034824034, from
Argo CD v3.5.3 as installed by `scripts/ci/setup-gitops-controllers.sh` on a
kind cluster. `applications.json` is `kubectl get applications.argoproj.io -A
-o json` after the lane deployed `examples/delivery-tree/argocd` at commit
`b7bda177`. The file is the artifact's bytes, unedited; `SHA256SUMS` lists it.

It holds eight Applications: the seven of the example and `guestbook`, which
the lane deploys for its other checks.

| Application | What the controller left on it |
|---|---|
| `delivery-tree` | Synced, Healthy. Reports three plain resources and four Applications, one of them in another namespace |
| `delivery-tree-team-a` | Synced. Reports two Applications |
| `delivery-tree-web`, `delivery-tree-jobs` | Synced. Report a Deployment, a Service and ConfigMaps |
| `delivery-tree-team-b` | No automated sync, so OutOfSync and Missing. It still reports `delivery-tree-api`, as OutOfSync: the Application it would create, which does not exist |
| `delivery-tree-broken` | Its path does not exist. Sync Unknown, a `ComparisonError` condition, and no `status.resources` |
| `delivery-tree-elsewhere` | In a namespace this Argo CD does not read Applications from. No status at all |

What it shows:

- `status.resources[]` carries `group`, `version`, `kind`, `namespace`, `name`
  and `status`. It carries no health for any entry;
  `status.resourceHealthSource` is `appTree`.
- An entry is what the Application wants, not only what exists. An OutOfSync
  entry can name an object that was never created.
- An Application that could not be compared has no `status.resources`, and one
  that nothing reconciles has no status.

What it does not show: an Application with many resources, a resource that
needs pruning, a hook, an Application generated by an ApplicationSet, or a
deployment with resource health persisted on the Application.

The repository URL and commit in each `spec` are this repository's. No
credential is in the file.
